newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - November 8.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Attorney-General's Department says recent increase in price of gas by Shell Gas (Lanka) Ltd violates agreement with government.
New companies act aims to minimise fraudulent dealings by dierctors and protect workers, Labour Ministry says.
Army kills 11 Tamil rebels in operation to clear Valikamam West in Jaffna peninsula.
LTTE rebels kill two soldiers in attack on Vavuniya army defences.
Government's 1997 budget will boost economic development, industrialists and investors say.
